name: Rankdar SEO
author: Rankdar

sections.description:
Rankdar reads your site and writes a plan in plain words: what to fix, the keywords your customers search, and the pages to write. With this plugin, you send a fix from your plan to your site, and it waits on the plugin’s page in your WordPress dashboard. There you see the value on your site now and the new one, and apply it with one click, or dismiss it. Your plan in Rankdar then shows the fix as done. Every change can be undone from the same page.

Works the way you choose

  • Alongside your SEO plugin: with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO or SEOPress, Rankdar writes its fixes into that plugin’s own fields. Nothing is printed twice.
  • As your only SEO plugin: Rankdar prints the title and description of each page, noindex, Open Graph and Twitter tags, and adds an SEO box to the editor. One click copies your titles and descriptions from the plugin you used before.

What it can fix

  • The title and description shown in search results, for any page, post or the home page.
  • A page hidden from search engines (noindex), or a whole site set to “discourage search engines”.
  • Schema: WebSite, your business (clinic, store, restaurant, company…) with its city and country, and each page or article; and any structured data you build in Rankdar’s schema section (product, event, FAQ, breadcrumbs, service, person, video…) for one page.
  • llms.txt: a guide to your pages and latest articles for AI assistants.
  • robots.txt: lets search engines and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) read the site, and names your sitemap.

Safe by design

  • Rankdar never gets your WordPress password. The site is connected with a one-time code, and every request is signed and checked.
  • Rankdar never changes your site from outside. It can read your SEO settings and send fixes; only an administrator applies them, in the dashboard.
  • Disconnect at any time, here or in Rankdar.

External services

This plugin connects your site to Rankdar (https://rankdar.com), an SEO platform, so that fixes from your Rankdar plan can be sent to your site and applied by you in the WordPress dashboard. It needs a Rankdar account. Sending a fix, applying it and undoing it cost nothing; writing the site plan the fixes come from uses the account’s credits (plans and prices, including a free plan: https://rankdar.com/pricing).

  • When you press “Connect to Rankdar”: your browser opens rankdar.com with your site’s address, the plugin’s version and the address of this plugin’s settings page. After you approve, your site sends rankdar.com the one-time code, the site’s address, its REST API address, the WordPress and plugin versions and the name of the active SEO plugin, and receives the connection’s secret.
  • When you open your plan in Rankdar: Rankdar asks your site for its status. Your site answers with the plugin and WordPress versions, the active SEO plugin, how Rankdar works next to it, the site’s name and address, the address of this plugin’s settings page, and the plugin’s settings: search visibility, llms.txt, the tools allowed in robots.txt, the sitemap line, and the business described in schema (its kind, name, city, country and phone). It adds whether the server has its own robots.txt or llms.txt, whether WordPress serves its own sitemap, whether this plugin prints the page tags, which fixes from Rankdar wait here, and the changes applied from them (each with its field, the page’s address, the values before and after, and the time).
  • When you send a fix from your plan: Rankdar asks your site for the values the fix would change: a page’s title, description, noindex and structured data, with the page’s ID, type, title, address and edit link, and the settings above. Then it sends the fix, which waits on this plugin’s settings page.
  • These requests never change your site. A fix changes it only when an administrator applies it on the plugin’s settings page.
  • When you apply, dismiss or undo a fix in the dashboard: your site tells rankdar.com what happened. For each fix it sends its key, the field and the page’s address; for a fix applied or undone, also the values before and after and the time. It adds the name of the active SEO plugin and the plugin’s version.
  • When you press “Disconnect”: your site tells rankdar.com that the connection ended.

Nothing is sent before you connect, and nothing about your site’s visitors is ever sent. Rankdar’s terms: https://rankdar.com/terms — privacy policy: https://rankdar.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New Plugin, search for “Rankdar SEO”, then install and activate it. (With the zip from Rankdar: Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.)
  2. Go to Settings → Rankdar SEO and press “Connect to Rankdar”.
  3. Approve the site in Rankdar. Back in your plan, press “Send to WordPress” beside a fix, then apply it on Settings → Rankdar SEO.
sections.faq:
Do I need to remove Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

No. By default Rankdar works alongside them and writes into their fields. If you want Rankdar to be your only SEO plugin, choose it in the settings, import your titles and descriptions, then deactivate the other plugin.

My host has a robots.txt or llms.txt file on the server.

A real file is served before anything WordPress makes, so the plugin cannot change it. Rankdar tells you so and you edit the file yourself.

A security plugin blocks the requests.

Allow requests to /wp-json/rankdar/v1/. They are signed with your site’s secret and checked by the plugin.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Deactivating it keeps everything. Deleting it from the Plugins page removes its settings, the connection, the fixes waiting and their history, the structured data it added to pages, and the titles, descriptions and noindex it keeps when it is your only SEO plugin, on every site of a network. What it wrote into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO or SEOPress stays in that plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.2.4

  • The llms.txt link for plain permalinks answers only at the site’s address; other pages, the dashboard and the login page stay as they are.

1.2.3

  • The sitemap named in robots.txt is the address WordPress or your SEO plugin gives for it, with plain permalinks too, and none is named when no sitemap is on.
  • The links to view robots.txt and llms.txt work with plain permalinks.
  • Settings saved by version 1.2.0 are moved to WordPress’s loaded options on every supported WordPress version.

1.2.2

  • A page’s structured data keeps an empty object as it was written, and its full view shows every character as it will be printed.
  • Titles and names in the schema and in llms.txt no longer carry HTML entities.
  • A server’s own robots.txt or llms.txt is found when the folder’s name has Arabic letters or spaces, and the plugin stays within the folders the host allows.
  • Fixes that waited from version 1.2.0 are cleaned once, as new ones are.

1.2.1

  • “Apply” and “Apply all” apply the fixes exactly as the page shows them. A fix Rankdar changed after the page opened is not applied, and waits for you to read it again.
  • A page’s structured data is shown in full before you apply it, and the business’s phone is shown with its other details.
  • Fixes from Rankdar are cleaned when they arrive, and shown as they will be written.
  • Undo says when a value was changed on your site after Rankdar’s change, and puts back the old value only if you ask again.
  • llms.txt is not served while the site asks search engines not to index it.
  • A server’s own robots.txt or llms.txt is found when WordPress lives in a subfolder.
  • Disconnecting removes the fixes waiting from Rankdar, the reminder to connect can be hidden, and deleting the plugin removes everything it kept.

1.2.0

  • Fixes from Rankdar wait on the plugin’s page, where an administrator applies, dismisses or undoes each one; Rankdar no longer changes the site from outside.
  • The dashboard says when Rankdar has sent fixes.

1.1.0

  • Structured data built in Rankdar’s schema section can be applied to any page (and removed), printed as its own JSON-LD block.

1.0.0

  • First release: connect to Rankdar, apply and undo fixes, work alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO and SEOPress or on its own, schema, llms.txt and robots.txt.

short_description: Apply the fixes of your Rankdar plan with one click, alongside your SEO plugin or as your only one. Built for Arabic sites.
